capabilities: Render pie-style progress clocks from YAML code blocks
Change filled slices and total slices with dropdowns
Insert a clock block from the command palette
Add, edit and delete clocks with on-block buttons
Set the outline and divider colour in settings
disambiguation: Not a timer or time-tracking tool; it draws progress clocks for Blades in the Dark.
extras: Saving a change re-serialises the block's YAML, so comments inside a clock block are not preserved. Not affiliated with or endorsed by One Seven Design or Evil Hat Productions.
problem: Progress clocks for Blades in the Dark games have to be drawn by hand or tracked outside the note.

relations.evidence: This work is based on Blades in the Dark

summary: Renders Blades in the Dark progress clocks from YAML code blocks, with editable slice counts, labels and descriptions.
